subject: info-intr
title: (R)INFO.INTR.------TRS.
description: Diagram in NYM-5. (R)INFO-INTR — the *reality* of information interpretation — is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram poses what real interpretation requires when crossed with the transition the post-Ayler movement was undergoing. Besides the main line to TRS (the crossing), three lines leave the subject. PRI-INFO (principle information) → AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → INT (intention). POL-DYM (political dynamics) → SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars) → PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). MTA-IMP (meta-implications) → MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) → C-CONT (composite continuance).
